Search existing issues and review the roadmap before proposing new work.

## Problem and audience

Who needs this change, and what concrete problem does it solve?

## Proposed outcome

Describe the desired behavior or documentation improvement and a practical example.

## Alternatives and scope

Describe alternatives considered, relevant roadmap phase, and compatibility or safety
considerations. Do not include secrets or private project information.

## Validation

Explain how a reviewer could determine that the proposed change solves the problem.
